text_simplified: A murabbi (one who provides tarbiyah) must be a good role model for their children, enjoining them to do good and forbidding them from evil while applying that to themselves first. It is important that children see the murabbi’s behavior matching their words so that the influence is deeper and more effective.

review_defects.why: The English adds a parenthetical definition not present in the Arabic; the Arabic simply says 'the educator/mentor' without gloss, so the English says something the Arabic does not.

review_defects.arabic: يجب على المربي أن يكون قدوة حسنة لأبنائه
review_defects.english: A murabbi (one who provides tarbiyah) must be a good role model for their children
review_defects.why: The English is stiff and clinical with the transliterated term and parenthetical, whereas the Arabic is direct and warm.
